),
with_result AS (
    SELECT player_api_id,
        CASE
            WHEN position = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN position = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'loss'
            WHEN position = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN position = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal THEN 'loss'
            ELSE 'draw'
        END AS result
    FROM player_matches
    WHERE result != 'draw'
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT player_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
    FROM with_result
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, ps.win_count, ps.loss_count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM player_stats)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.player_name, ps.win_count, ps.loss_count
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM player_stats)
